worked.problem: The seven daily study times (minutes) are 9, 12, 12, 16, 19, 21, 24. Find the mean to two decimals.
actions: Arrange the seven given times and count n = 7.
Add every value: Σx = 113 minutes.
Use mean = Σx/n = 113/7.
Divide: mean = 16.14 minutes.
Answer: Mean = 16.14. Check the mean lies between 9 and 24 minutes.
